skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop and refine techniques for interpreting between languages, focusing on economic and business contexts.
Enhance proficiency in both source and target languages, particularly in economic and business terminology.
Master the art of quick and accurate note-taking during interpretation.
Expand vocabulary in specialized economic and business fields.
Improve the ability to critically listen and understand complex economic and business content.
Refine the ability to clearly and accurately convey messages in the target language.
Develop a mindset for continuous learning and improvement in interpretation skills.
Understand and adhere to professional ethics in interpretation.
Manage time effectively during interpretation tasks.
Work effectively in groups to enhance interpretation skills.
Apply problem-solving skills to overcome challenges in interpretation.
Adapt to different contexts and scenarios in interpretation.
